name: Exposure - Appalachia
source:
In Exposure Appalachia, you play as a recent college graduate who’s finally going on their dream hike by taking on a local portion of the Appalachian Trail. Armed with a new point-and-shoot digital camera and a state-of-the-art MP3 player, your multi-day hike takes a dark turn when you find yourself lost in the woods. You find that things aren’t quite right as you encounter unexplainable happenings and otherworldly creatures. 

Will you make it out alive?

[From [url=https://borderbreakers.itch.io/exposure-appalachia]itch.io[/url]]
